success_case: passed: real Kiln build, host kill/restart, canonical completion and terminal status
failure_case: project completed but controller completion stalled after the restarted Aspen host exited
causes: The restarted Aspen host exited on `write Aspen host response: Broken pipe` when a client disconnected, so the next broker request never completed.

The harness `read_file` returned only the diagnostic record tail (last 4000 chars), corrupting the 14394-byte `kiln-provider-api/lib.rs` before commit; the Nix diagnostic was an accidental parse error rather than the injected failure.
fixes: The Aspen host now logs per-connection read/decode/encode/write failures and continues to the next bounded request; the accepted host test abandons a connection before completing three real exchanges.
`read_file` returns the full bounded stdout of `head -c LIMIT`; the injected failure is a syntax error containing the configured marker.
